items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: his brother- in-law and sister-in-law, the ones who introduced John T to me

ctx.x: And John T’s son was staying with the Wrights, they were very wealthy, his brother- in-law and sister-in-law, the ones who introduced John T to me. He went to school with the Jacksons, you know.
When you had to leave them, how did you feel?
